import json, os, sys
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

root = Path(os.environ["S05_HW_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT"])
provenance = root / "teleop_code_provenance.json"
p = json.loads(provenance.read_bytes())
verified = {}
for path, declared in p["files"].items():
    actual = sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert actual == declared["sha256"], path
    assert (actual == declared["head_sha256"]) == declared["is_same_as_head"], path
    assert (root / path).stat().st_size == declared["bytes"], path
    verified[path] = actual

def align(src, dst):
    cx, cy = src.mean(0), dst.mean(0)
    u, _, v = np.linalg.svd((src-cx).T @ (dst-cy))
    d = np.eye(3)
    d[2, 2] = np.linalg.det(v.T @ u.T)
    R = v.T @ d @ u.T
    return R, cy - R @ cx

theta = .27
R_true = np.array([[np.cos(theta), -np.sin(theta), 0.],
                   [np.sin(theta), np.cos(theta), 0.], [0., 0., 1.]])
shift = np.array([.035, -.02, .01])
train = np.array([[0.,0.,0.],[.2,0.,0.],[0.,.3,0.],[0.,0.,.4],[.2,.3,.1]])
holdout = np.array([[.1,.08,.12],[.11,.20,.13],[-.11,.04,.20]])
fitting = train @ R_true.T + shift
test = holdout @ R_true.T + shift
R,t = align(train,fitting)
pred = holdout @ R.T+t
base_err = np.linalg.norm(pred-test,axis=1).max()
delta_plus = (test + [0.,0.003,0.] - pred).mean(0)
delta_minus = (test - [0.,0.003,0.] - pred).mean(0)
mirror_train = train * [-1.,1.,1.]
M,v = align(train,mirror_train)
mirror_residual = np.linalg.norm(train @ M.T+v-mirror_train,axis=1).max()
assert base_err < 1e-12 and abs(np.linalg.det(R)-1.) < 1e-12 and abs(np.linalg.det(M)-1.) < 1e-12
assert delta_plus[1] > .001 and delta_minus[1] < -.001 and mirror_residual > .001

def causal(capture, visible, tick, cutoff, generation, current_generation):
    if generation != current_generation:
        return "BLOCK_GENERATION"
    if capture is None or visible is None:
        return "BLOCK_MISSING"
    if capture[0] > capture[1] or visible[0] > visible[1]:
        return "BLOCK_REVERSED_BOUNDS"
    if capture[1] > tick:
        return "BLOCK_CAPTURE_AFTER_TICK"
    if visible[1] > cutoff:
        return "BLOCK_VISIBLE_AFTER_CUTOFF"
    return "PASS_SYNTHETIC"

causal_cases = {
    "unmodified": causal((890,900),(950,960),1000,980,7,7),
    "minus_30_ns": causal((890,900),(920,930),1000,980,7,7),
    "plus_20_ns_cutoff_equal": causal((890,900),(970,980),1000,980,7,7),
    "plus_30_ns": causal((890,900),(980,990),1000,980,7,7),
    "capture_upper_over_tick": causal((890,1001),(950,960),1000,980,7,7),
    "restart_generation": causal((890,900),(950,960),1000,980,6,7),
    "unobserved_capture": causal(None,(950,960),1000,980,7,7),
    "reversed_bounds": causal((900,890),(950,960),1000,980,7,7),
}
assert causal_cases == dict(unmodified="PASS_SYNTHETIC", minus_30_ns="PASS_SYNTHETIC",
    plus_20_ns_cutoff_equal="PASS_SYNTHETIC", plus_30_ns="BLOCK_VISIBLE_AFTER_CUTOFF",
    capture_upper_over_tick="BLOCK_CAPTURE_AFTER_TICK", restart_generation="BLOCK_GENERATION",
    unobserved_capture="BLOCK_MISSING", reversed_bounds="BLOCK_REVERSED_BOUNDS")
issue = ("session-A","boot-1",7,"left-arm",1)
feedback_uid = ("HW-A", "axis-group-L","fb-boot-1",7,71,11_000)
def applied(uid, ack_uid, ack_semantics, ack_ns, feedback, device_generation):
    if ack_uid is None:
        return "BLOCK_MISSING_ACK"
    if uid[2] != device_generation or feedback[3] != device_generation:
        return "BLOCK_GENERATION"
    if uid != ack_uid:
        return "BLOCK_ID_MISMATCH"
    if ack_semantics != "DEVICE_APPLIED":
        return "BLOCK_SUBMISSION_ONLY"
    if feedback[-1] < ack_ns:
        return "BLOCK_FEEDBACK_BEFORE_APPLICATION"
    return "PASS_SYNTHETIC"

join_cases = {
    "exact_ack": applied(issue,issue,"DEVICE_APPLIED",10_500,feedback_uid,7),
    "same_time_wrong_sequence": applied(issue,(*issue[:-1],2),"DEVICE_APPLIED",10_500,feedback_uid,7),
    "missing_ack": applied(issue,None,None,10_500,feedback_uid,7),
    "application_after_feedback": applied(issue,issue,"DEVICE_APPLIED",11_001,feedback_uid,7),
    "sdk_return_only": applied(issue,issue,"SDK_SUBMISSION",10_500,feedback_uid,7),
    "stale_generation": applied(issue,issue,"DEVICE_APPLIED",10_500,feedback_uid,8),
}
assert join_cases == dict(exact_ack="PASS_SYNTHETIC",same_time_wrong_sequence="BLOCK_ID_MISMATCH",
    missing_ack="BLOCK_MISSING_ACK",application_after_feedback="BLOCK_FEEDBACK_BEFORE_APPLICATION",
    sdk_return_only="BLOCK_SUBMISSION_ONLY",stale_generation="BLOCK_GENERATION")
print(json.dumps(dict(
    source_verification=dict(worktree_head=p["head"], branch=p["branch"], dirty=p["dirty"],
        provenance_sha256=sha256(provenance.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        file_count=len(verified), differing_from_git_head=sum(not x["is_same_as_head"] for x in p["files"].values()),
        file_sha256=verified),
    geometry_synthetic=dict(holdout_max_residual_m=float(base_err), fitted_rot_det=float(np.linalg.det(R)),
        plus_y_m=float(delta_plus[1]), minus_y_m=float(delta_minus[1]), mirror_proper_fit_max_residual_m=float(mirror_residual),
        synthetic_limit_m=.001, result="PASS_SYNTHETIC"),
    causal_synthetic=causal_cases, command_application_join_synthetic=join_cases,
    local_runtime=dict(python=sys.version.split()[0],numpy=np.__version__),
    execution_scope="OBSERVED_OFFLINE_CONTENT_AND_SYNTHETIC_MATH_ONLY"
),indent=2))
